request: Content-type wildcard patterns passed to the compress middleware must all be of the form '<type>/*'. Any other pattern, including patterns that match every content type, must be rejected at construction time like the other unsupported wildcard patterns, not silently accepted. Valid patterns such as 'text/*' keep working.

defects.description: NewCompressor rejects wildcard patterns only when a '*' survives after trimming a trailing '/*'. A bare '/*' trims to the empty string, contains no '*', and is accepted as a wildcard matching every content type, silently compressing everything the caller meant to exclude.
traps: '*/*' already panics in the fixture, so a probe that only tries '*/*' stays green on the fixture and never distinguishes the defect.
defects.why_missed: The shipped suite covers non-wildcard types and the panicking '*/*' pattern but never the bare '/*' catch-all, and no test observes which content types the compressor actually matches after construction.
